settings.title: Settings
settings.telegramOff: The bot is not configured: add TELEGRAM__TOKEN to deploy/.env and restart the hive.
settings.codeHint: Send the bot this command within 10 minutes:
settings.totpScan: Scan the QR code in Google Authenticator or a similar app, then enter the 6 digits:
settings.recovery: Recovery codes. Keep them: each works once, if the phone is not at hand.
settings.languageHint: One setting for the whole hive. Applies to everyone after the page reloads.
settings.wifiHint: The network and password for boards that join the hive. The password is stored encrypted and never shown.
settings.wifiPasswordKept: Password is set (leave empty to keep it)
settings.languageAdminOnly: Only an admin changes the hive language
settings.monitorHint: See how the hornets and the hive talk, read-only.

swarm.title: Swarm
swarm.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? The board loses access to the hive; its history stays.
swarm.replaceHint: New board for {id}: flash it and enter this code in the wizard's setup step (or with the enroll command). The old board loses access.
swarm.sleepSaved: Saved. The hornet applies it at its next wake-up
swarm.sleepHint: For battery hornets: wakes, sends a reading and sleeps. Needs a GPIO16–RST jumper (docs/hornet-esp01-battery.md)
swarm.pinsSaved: Pins saved. The hornet applies them on its next connection
swarm.pinsRejected: Pins not saved: a conflict or a bad number
swarm.pinsNone: No pins to set for this type
swarm.updateConfirm: Update “{name}” over the air: {from} → {to}? The hornet downloads the firmware, restarts and reports the result.
swarm.updateRisk: The ESP-01 keeps the new image beside the old one and cannot roll back: if power fails during the copy, the board must be reflashed over USB. Update one hornet first.
swarm.updateStarted: Update started: progress shows in events
swarm.updateRefused: The update was not started (check the board, the version and the hive address in Settings)

add.idHint: Latin letters in lower case, digits and dashes; starts with a letter
add.flashHint: Connect the board over USB (ESP32-CAM-MB or a USB-UART adapter). Flashing takes about a minute.
add.noSerial: This browser has no Web Serial: open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
add.noFirmware: No built firmware for type {type}: build it in PlatformIO (env {type}-<board>).
add.downloadHint: You can flash the file by hand (esptool or another flasher) or later over the air (OTA). A browser without Web Serial, such as Firefox, cannot flash, but it can download the file.
add.alreadyFlashed: If the board is already flashed, go to step 3.
add.hiveHint: The hive address as the board sees it: the IP of the computer or Raspberry Pi, not localhost.
add.send: Send to the board over USB
add.waitingOnline: The board got its login and is rebooting; waiting for it to come online…
add.failed: It did not work. Check the Wi-Fi, the hive address and that the code has not expired; the board log is above.
add.manual: By hand, in the serial monitor
add.batchTitle: A batch of hornets of one type
add.batchHint: Pick a hornet, flash its board (you can close the window and come back later: the queue is on the server), then set it up. Wi-Fi and the hive address are entered for each board.
add.wifiFromHive: Wi-Fi and the hive address come from the hive settings

boards.esp-01-dht11: ESP-01S with a DHT11 sensor (the “ESP-01S DHT11” module)

monitor.title: MQTT monitor
monitor.hint: Read-only: the latest messages from hornets and the hive. Nothing is sent from here, and no broker login is needed.
monitor.failed: Could not get the messages (admin sign-in needed)
